abstract_sentences.text: Recent advances in the audio language modeling (ALM) domain tackle audio understanding and text-to-audio generation as separate tasks.

evidence.anchor: tackle audio understanding and text-to-audio generation as separate tasks

abstract_sentences.text: Very few studies attempt to unify these tasks – an essential step toward advanced multimodal reasoning.

evidence.anchor: Very few studies attempt to unify these tasks

abstract_sentences.text: This paper introduces Unified Audio Language Model (UALM), which aims to unify audio understanding, text-to-audio generation, and multimodal reasoning in a single model.

evidence.anchor: unify audio understanding, text-to-audio generation, and multimodal reasoning in a single model

abstract_sentences.text: To achieve this goal, we first present UALM-Gen, a text-to-audio language model that directly predicts audio tokens and is comparable to state-of-the-art diffusion-based models.

evidence.anchor: directly predicts audio tokens and is comparable to state-of-the-art diffusion-based models

abstract_sentences.text: We then demonstrate, using proper data blending, training recipes, and inference techniques, that our single UALM model matches the quality of state-of-the-art specialized models in audio understanding, text-to-audio generation, and text reasoning.

evidence.anchor: our single UALM model matches the quality of state-of-the-art specialized models

abstract_sentences.text: Furthermore, we present UALM-Reason, a multimodal reasoning model that utilizes both text and audio in the intermediate thinking steps to facilitate complex generation tasks.

evidence.anchor: utilizes both text and audio in the intermediate thinking steps

abstract_sentences.text: To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration in audio research of cross-modal generative reasoning, with its effectiveness confirmed by subjective evaluations.

evidence.anchor: first demonstration in audio research of cross-modal generative reasoning

evidence.anchor: In summary, this work presents the following contributions

related_work_moves.description: 按 diffusion、autoregressive LM 和 hybrid 对 text-to-audio 方法分类，并引出本文的 scaling/recipe 对比。

evidence.anchor: broadly classified as diffusion models, auto-regressive language model approaches, and their hybrids

related_work_moves.description: 承认 DPO 在 diffusion 与其他音频框架中的基础，强调本文把 DPO 纳入 LM-based TTA，同时指出 CLAP 与人类偏好的差距。

related_work_moves.description: 将既有 audio reasoning 归为 text-centric understanding，把 MusiCoT 的 intermediate CLAP latents 与 UALM 的理解/生成联合推理对照。

related_work_moves.description: 区分面向低延迟 speech-to-speech 的 SLM 与一般 audio/text task unification，并指出单调对齐假设不适用。

final_judgment.single_storyline: 以 decoder-only LLM 为共同骨架，让连续音频理解和离散音频生成共享空间，再用 rich caption 将用户意图、生成结果和 critique 串成 multimodal CoT；该链由 p.3–p.9 的架构、recipe、benchmark 和 demo 贯通。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Fig.2 的共享接口/配比、Eq.1–2 的 CFG/DPO 定义、Fig.5 的机制诊断和 Tables 1–4 的三域结果与 reasoning 主观分数。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: RVQ/delay pattern、Enhancement VAE 七个损失公式、训练/推理超参数、完整生成消融和 Mechanical Turk 场景细节移入 Appendix B/C；seed、分母、CI 算法和评审人数仍未提供。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Fig.3–4 将 rich caption 与三种轨迹可视化，Fig.5 将 recipe 转为过程诊断，Table 8 以 Base→DPO→Enhancement VAE 的逐层链把组件连接到 FD/CL/AES。
final_judgment.largest_gap: first cross-modal generative reasoning 缺少系统性外部基线；reasoning controllability 主要依赖每类 20 条的主观评测和 demo；统一模型在 MMAR 与文本 Mean 的代价被 competitive/marginal 语气概括。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 多模态统一模型应同时展示共享接口、每项任务直接结果和共享 recipe 的逐层消融，并让异质指标与自我限制留在同一证据链。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于多任务/多模态工程模型；若主张依赖 theorem 或因果机制，仍需显式假设、证明或预定义机制对照，不能用 benchmark 并列和主观 MOS 替代。

statistical_analysis.aggregation_unit: 客观生成表的 test-set aggregate point estimates；理解/文本为 benchmark accuracy；reasoning 为场景级 Mechanical Turk 5-scale MOS。具体 test-set 分母、评审人数和音频-评审映射未报告。
statistical_analysis.center: FD/KL/IS/CL/AES 为 point metrics；OVL/REL 与 Table 4 为 mean opinion scores。
statistical_analysis.uncertainty: Table 1 注明 OVL/REL 95% CI ≈ 0.10；Table 4 报 mean ± 95% CI；CI 计算方法未说明。
statistical_analysis.decision_quantities: best/second-best formatting、accuracy Mean、CLAP gap 0.15、CE/CU/PC/PQ all-positive filtering、DPO divergence 曲线。
statistical_analysis.seed_task_dataset_levels: 任务和数据集层级可见；seed 数量/跨 seed 方差 unavailable。
statistical_analysis.interpretation_boundary: 论文区分了 prompt adherence/quality、text capability 和 subjective controllability 的对象，但没有把 statistical significance、practical significance 和 mechanism evidence 以正式检验分开。
